home.cashflowDesc: We read ledger stability factors, consistent deposits, and recurrent subscriptions rather than static scoring matrices.
home.fairLendingDesc: Explicit mitigation algorithms prevent demographic bias, keeping evaluations strictly focused on financial numbers and true cash safety.
home.fraudDesc: Integrated pattern recognizers compare metadata structures against hundreds of tampering behaviors automatically.

home.featureNeuralDesc: Our proprietary multi-layer neural network looks beyond legacy credit scores to assess alternative cashflow habits instantly.
home.featureRapidDesc: Complete our simplified digital criteria questionnaire and receive an instant, accurate underwriting pre-approval output.
home.featureOcrDesc: Zero manual transcription. Upload tax profiles and paystubs; our OCR auto-parses and matches metadata with military-grade safety.
home.whyChooseDesc: By taking advantage of deep-learning algorithms, we restructure the traditional friction points of personal and commercial borrowing, bringing unmatched speed, accessibility, and transparency.
home.benefitEnhancedApprovalDesc: Alternative scoring parameters recognize stable income streams traditional systems overlook, raising baseline approvals by 27%.
home.benefitAprDesc: Instead of strict rigid tiering, our reinforcement engine computes custom rates aligned exactly to your debt-to-income bandwidth.
home.benefitPrivacyDesc: All submitted KYC assets are dynamically redacted during analysis, securing absolute confidentiality across databases.
home.benefitIntegrationDesc: Compatible with standard bank ledger configurations, simplifying manual loan officer audits with robust metadata transparency.

about.objectivesTitle: The Three Core Pillars of Degital
about.pageSubtitle: Learn more about the project goals, core mathematical objectives, technological stack, and researchers behind this modern underwriting SaaS simulator.
about.genesisPara1: The traditional financial apparatus evaluates risk using methods created in the mid-20th century. Standard credit reports represent historical payments but fail to capture real-time financial trajectory or asset stability.
about.genesisPara2: Degital AI Loan System is an academic simulation built to showcase the feasibility of decentralized, automated credit assessments. By integrating high-fidelity document parsing (OCR) and alternative cashflow modeling, Degital predicts debt-to-income sustainability in real-time, removing biases and streamlining officer review queues.
about.blueprintQuote: "Our simulation bridges user-submitted data with algorithmic rate-setting, proving that digital OCR automation can slash application assessment latencies from weeks to under five seconds safely."
about.objectiveAccuracyDesc: Move past static 3-digit legacy scores by predicting default probability with multiple concurrent data variables.
about.objectiveAccessDesc: Establish alternative paths to credit for self-employed individuals, creators, and micro-entrepreneurs.
about.objectivePrivacyDesc: Verify financial files dynamically through client-redacted server pipelines, maintaining strict bank compliance.

aiFeaturesPage.howItWorksTitle: How Degital AI Models Risk Safely
aiFeaturesPage.pageSubtitle: Hover or click over each card to execute a dynamic flip, revealing detailed structural insights, computational models, and security compliance matrices.
aiFeaturesPage.howItWorksBody: Traditional credit assessment ignores cashflow dynamics, penalizing entrepreneurs with non-traditional schedules. Degital employs predictive, bias-mitigated learning pipelines that prioritize recurrent liquidity factors and income verity over legacy scores.
aiFeaturesPage.complianceBody: Degital AI Underwriting runs fully on deterministic simulated math parameters designed for academic prototyping. No actual personal debt files are indexed or queried, ensuring absolute compliance with current financial sandbox safety practices.
aiFeaturesPage.riskAssessmentDesc: Advanced machine learning models analyze multiple traditional and alternative data points in seconds to generate highly precise credit risk ratings.
aiFeaturesPage.riskAssessmentBenefit: Analyzes credit risk in 5 seconds flat with extreme accuracy.
aiFeaturesPage.riskAssessmentDeepDive: Our algorithms utilize neural networks to process banking transaction logs, cashflow stability metrics, and regional credit trends, delivering a comprehensive risk percentage and credit health score to keep approval ratios stable.
aiFeaturesPage.ocrDocumentDesc: Upload your documents and let our smart optical character recognition models parse, analyze, and verify your KYC credentials instantly.
aiFeaturesPage.ocrDocumentBenefit: Eliminates manual entry by instantly reading tax forms & IDs.
aiFeaturesPage.ocrDocumentDeepDive: Equipped with computer vision and layout parser modules, our OCR system reads tax files, bank statements, and IDs. It detects tamper anomalies, verifies structural integrity, and auto-populates relevant banking details.
aiFeaturesPage.personalizedRecsDesc: Our recommendations engine reviews your financials to propose ideal loan amounts, tenure splits, and interest options customized to your wallet.
aiFeaturesPage.personalizedRecsBenefit: Matches you with the lowest-interest product for your profile.
aiFeaturesPage.personalizedRecsDeepDive: Using deep reinforcement learning, the engine models multiple repayment paths to find the optimal balance of monthly budget flexibility and minimal aggregate interest, guiding you to a stress-free loan setup.
aiFeaturesPage.multilingualSupportDesc: Communicate, read agreements, and evaluate risk options in your native language with our natural language processing support agent.
aiFeaturesPage.multilingualSupportBenefit: Demystifies complex banking legal terms in 15+ languages.
aiFeaturesPage.multilingualSupportDeepDive: Powered by highly optimized local Large Language Models, our interface translates fine-print legal disclosures, provides plain-text summaries, and answers questions in real-time, making banking universally accessible.
